name: STEREO
summary: STEREO measured antineutrinos from uranium-235 fission at ILL using a six-cell detector. Comparing the cell spectra across a very short baseline tested whether sterile-neutrino oscillations explain the reactor-antineutrino anomaly.
detection_principle: Gadolinium-loaded liquid scintillator detects inverse beta decay. Six optically separated target cells sample different core distances while sharing response calibration; reactor-off periods constrain backgrounds.

results.summary: No position-dependent oscillation was found in the tested region. The measured flux deficit and spectrum favour deficiencies in source predictions over the targeted sterile-oscillation explanation.
